scope: STATIC SOURCE ENDPOINTS ONLY. No generated frames, continuous motion, song synchronization, final edit, or full scene acceptance.

inspection.note: Scratch FFmpeg-only crops are review aids at native scale, not production inputs. New operator crops must preserve reviewed functional content and be bound to their own exact bytes.

pairs.observed: Both people are fully inside at the end, but the physical entrance changes. Before, active door occupies approximately local x418–628; an adjacent cross-marked fixed glass pane is x645–758. After, the clear opening expands to x418–760 and that fixed pane/jamb has disappeared.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: This is not a rejection of a legitimately moving door leaf. Preserve the same active opening, hinge, jamb and adjacent fixed glazing in both endpoints; place people deeper inside that consistent opening. Act2 is preparing a focused corrected end using the before frame geometry.

pairs.observed: Woman stands coated at B then sits in indoor striped sleeves at B; her burgundy coat occupies A, Jaro remains standing/coated by C, D stays empty. All feet, hands, crowns and four seats fit.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Animation must show her own hands removing/placing the coat, self-supported lowering onto B and release to lap. No coat morphing, seat swap, pulling by Jaro or foot skating. This approval applies only to the bottom pair, not the flawed entrance above.

authority: Root owns canon/contract changes. Artist and reviewer are separate. No generator or GPU operation performed by reviewer.
